plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Redline transmission device. It reports uptime and interface traffic, for AN80i PTP and PMP (enterprise PEN 10728).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: sinadr
metrics.description: AN80i average SINADR (signal to interference, noise and distortion ratio) from the an80iIfAvrSinAdr scalar under PEN 10728. The SNMP object is Integer32 with no scaling. This prefers the PTP scalar over PMP table columns; PMP-only radios that omit the scalar skip the row.

metrics.name: dl_rssi
metrics.description: AN80i PMP downlink RSSI from an80iIfPmpLinkDLRssi, indexed by an80iIfPmpLinkId. The collector walks the PMP link identifier first, then reads the DL RSSI column. Integer32 with no scaling. PTP RSSI scalars are not used.

metrics.name: ul_rssi
metrics.description: Optional AN80i PMP uplink RSSI from an80iIfPmpLinkULRssi, indexed by an80iIfPmpLinkId. The collector walks the PMP link identifier first, then reads the UL RSSI column. Integer32 with no scaling. Missing rows on some firmware revisions are skipped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
